apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(host): prompt for a name when the synced Nuvio profile is unnamed (`376e0241`)
- fix(android): fill the TV banner instead of letterboxing the wordmark (`e9e30e3e`)
- perf(host): read the shared snapshot and compare home rows by pointer (`e0d13b37`)
- perf(ui): build the home model from shared rows (`3034b1d9`)
- perf(app): publish snapshots as shared slices instead of one cloned value (`14e90612`)
- perf(core): share home rows and snapshot slices through Arc (`b943e329`)
- feat(host): split present into encode, submit and present timings (`c056d556`)
- perf(ui): solve home row slots with the packed row path (`15623947`)
- perf(ui): place sized card rows without building a flex tree (`b10efb8e`)
- feat(host): enable frame stats on Android through a marker file (`022c4880`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.5...v0.3.6
